possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card provides only architecture, merge method, and base model names; no training/evaluation details for this checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: Merge of two named 14B models with no stated training data sources or verification of their provenance.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: No documentation of training or tuning dataset details for the merged checkpoint or its components.

possible_risks.description: Without access to the training data, the types of explanations a model can provide are limited and more likely to be incorrect.
possible_risks.justification: No training data access is provided for the merged model or its base models.

possible_risks.description: The content of the training data used for generating the model's output is not accessible.
possible_risks.justification: Training data content is not accessible, so outputs cannot be attributed to specific training sources.

specifications.model_size: 27.5 GiB of safetensors weights (29,531,962,384 bytes) in BF16
